firstContext: ◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
Maya came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.

loss.line: Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.

firenarr.line: ⚠ The store has fallen far from its recent high again — the shelves are nearly bare.
